_comment: Source of truth for the review wall on index.html. Rendered into HTML by build.js (npm run build) - the site does NOT fetch this at runtime. See scripts/README-reviews.md.

bullets: The gated, fenced access is the most praised feature - renters repeatedly say it lets them stop worrying about their belongings.
Units and grounds are consistently described as clean and well maintained.
Renting, paying, and moving out are all called out as fast and easy, online or by phone.

reviews.author: Donna Carson
reviews.text: I've been renting from this location over the years off and on. I am thrilled with now having the gated security used by the current owners. It definitely allows me the ability to rest easy that my property is protected and has security.
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you for the kind review Donna and I'm glad we could help! - Mona

reviews.author: Robin Ward
reviews.text: Great people to work with. Storage units and grounds are clean. Love that it has a security gate. Highly recommend.
reviews.ownerReply: Thank you for the kind review. We have worked to keep the facility clean, well lit with updated security cameras.

reviews.author: Denise S.
reviews.text: I'm extremely pleased that it's gated. I know my belongings are safe. I have rented for 3 years and have never had any problems. My payments are automatic every month. I don't have to worry about payments.

reviews.author: Josh B.
reviews.text: This was a fantastic online experience for a small town storage unit company. Clean and gated area.
